HIT: The opponent must discard 1 card per card discarded during this Strike.

name: Ivory Ghost Charge
effect: BEFORE: If you were hit during this Strike, close 3 spaces.

name: Gyro Chain Gash

HIT: Discard up to 3 cards at random. For each card discarded this way, +1 Power and the opponent must discard a card.

name: Ivory Ghost Impalement
effect: BEFORE: If you were hit during this Strike, +3 Power.

name: Revenger

boost.name: Fates Crossing
effect: Strike. Both players must declare Wild Swings.
HIT: The opponent discards 2 cards at random, then add top card of your discard to your Gauge.

name: Shadow Of Death

effect: If you are at range 1, both players must discard their hands.
If you do not have enough Gauge to use this attack after it is revealed during a Wild Swing, add it to your hand and add the top 2 cards of your Discard to your Gauge.
